terra.problem: The passage does not say the crowd was chewing or that its attention changed.
The list is not simply about who the disciple is. It also names family members.
The deed joke does not connect clearly to the action in the passage.
The explanation is flat and repeats the carrying-and-following point without adding much.
The claim that a mat appears in other Bible stories needs a reference.
The passage does not say counting comes before every other possible step.
Jesus says the builder lays a foundation and cannot finish. He does not say the tower is half-built.
The passage says those who see the unfinished work ridicule the builder. It does not say nobody helps him.
Everyone who sees the unfinished work ridicules the builder. That does not establish that nobody looks away.
The king's supposed feeling about facing seven thousand men is not marked as Papa Dorin's guess.
The cookie line does not connect to the king's action and blends cookies into the war scenario.
The blanket claim about what a delegation does is not supported. Jesus specifies what this delegation asks for.
The passage does not say that every person in the crowd heard every word.
After the quotation, the explanation is generic and mostly repeats that Jesus spoke to the crowd.
